idea-plugin.name: Lotus Islands Theme
idea-plugin.description:
Lotus Islands is a collection of nine UI themes and matching editor color schemes for JetBrains IDEs with the Islands UI (2025.3+). Each theme is designed for readable syntax, visible keyboard focus, and clear boundaries between the editor and tool windows.

Each palette comes in Light, Dark, and Midnight.

  • Classic pairs violet accents with neutral surfaces.
  • Iridium pairs steel-blue accents with cool slate surfaces, indigo keywords, and blue function declarations.
  • Copper pairs terracotta accents with warm neutrals, clay-colored keywords, and bronze function declarations.

Light uses a nearly white editor, Dark uses charcoal, and Midnight uses a near-black canvas. Each palette carries its accent through active tabs, focus outlines, and search highlights.
